original_relay:
connectors:
  span_metrics: {}
exporters:
  debug: {}
  file/logs:
    compression: zstd
    compression_params:
      level: 3
    create_directory: true
    format: json
    path: /var/lib/otel/archive/logs/logs.json.zst
    rotation:
      localtime: false
      max_backups: 1000
      max_megabytes: 100
  file/metrics:
    compression: zstd
    compression_params:
      level: 3
    create_directory: true
    format: json
    path: /var/lib/otel/archive/metrics/metrics.json.zst
    rotation:
      localtime: false
      max_backups: 1000
      max_megabytes: 100
  file/traces:
    compression: zstd
    compression_params:
      level: 3
    create_directory: true
    format: json
    path: /var/lib/otel/archive/traces/traces.json.zst
    rotation:
      localtime: false
      max_backups: 1000
      max_megabytes: 100
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel-logs
    logs_index_time_format: yyyy-MM-dd
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 1s
      max_elapsed_time: 0s
      max_interval: 30s
    sending_queue:
      batch: {}
      enabled: true
      num_consumers: 4
      queue_size: 8589934592
      sizer: bytes
      storage: file_storage
  otlp_grpc/firepit:
    endpoint: firepit:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlp_grpc/jaeger:
    endpoint: jaeger:4317
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 1s
      max_elapsed_time: 0s
      max_interval: 30s
    sending_queue:
      batch: {}
      enabled: true
      num_consumers: 4
      queue_size: 8589934592
      sizer: bytes
      storage: file_storage
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlp_http/prometheus:
    endpoint: http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/otlp
    retry_on_failure:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 1s
      max_elapsed_time: 0s
      max_interval: 30s
    sending_queue:
      batch: {}
      enabled: true
      num_consumers: 4
      queue_size: 8589934592
      sizer: bytes
      storage: file_storage
    tls:
      insecure: true
extensions:
  file_storage:
    create_directory: true
    directory: /var/lib/otel/queue
    fsync: true
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
  opamp:
    agent_description:
      include_resource_attributes: true
      non_identifying_attributes:
        demo.collector.role: gateway
        deployment.environment.name: demo
    capabilities:
      reports_available_components: true
      reports_effective_config: true
      reports_health: true
    instance_uid: 00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001
    server:
      ws:
        endpoint: ws://opamp-server:4320/v1/opamp
processors:
  batch: {}
  filter/sanitize_profiles:
    error_mode: ignore
    profiles:
      profile:
      - IsMatch(resource.attributes["service.name"], "containerd-shim-.*")
  gen_ai_normalizer:
    sources:
    - name: openllmetry
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  resourcedetection:
    detectors:
    - env
    - system
  transform/sanitize_logs:
    error_mode: ignore
    log_statements:
    - context: scope
      statements:
      - set(attributes["otelcol_signal"], attributes["otelcol.signal"]) where attributes["otelcol.signal"]
        != nil and not IsMap(attributes["otelcol.signal"])
      - delete_key(attributes, "otelcol.signal") where attributes["otelcol_signal"]
        != nil
  transform/sanitize_spans:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - conditions:
      - span.kind == SPAN_KIND_SERVER and resource.attributes["service.name"] == "frontend"
        and span.attributes["http.route"] == nil
      context: span
      statements:
      - set(span.attributes["http.route"], "/api/cart") where IsMatch(span.attributes["http.target"],
        "\\/api\\/cart")
      - set(span.attributes["http.route"], "/api/checkout") where IsMatch(span.attributes["http.target"],
        "\\/api\\/checkout")
      - set(span.attributes["http.route"], "/api/products/{productId}") where IsMatch(span.attributes["http.target"],
        "\\/api\\/products\\/.*")
      - set(span.attributes["http.route"], "/api/recommendations") where IsMatch(span.attributes["http.target"],
        "\\/api\\/recommendations")
      - set(span.attributes["http.route"], "/api/data") where IsMatch(span.attributes["http.target"],
        "\\/api\\/data.*")
    - context: span
      statements:
      - set_semconv_span_name("1.37.0", "unsanitized_span_name")
receivers:
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  kafkametrics:
    brokers:
    - kafka:9092
    collection_interval: 10s
    scrapers:
    - brokers
    - topics
    - consumers
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_headers:
          - content-type
          - traceparent
          - baggage
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  prometheus/ad:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: ad
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ad:9465
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  - opamp
  - file_storage
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - opensearch
      - file/logs
      - debug
      processors:
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - transform/sanitize_logs
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - otlp_http/prometheus
      - file/metrics
      - debug
      processors:
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - kafkametrics
      - span_metrics
      - prometheus/ad
    profiles:
      exporters:
      - otlp_grpc/firepit
      - debug
      processors:
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - filter/sanitize_profiles
      receivers:
      - otlp
    traces:
      exporters:
      - otlp_grpc/jaeger
      - file/traces
      - debug
      - span_metrics
      processors:
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - transform/sanitize_logs
      - gen_ai_normalizer
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    logs:
      processors:
      - batch:
          exporter:
            otlp:
              endpoint: http://otel-collector:4318
              insecure: true
              protocol: http/protobuf
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - periodic:
          exporter:
            otlp:
              endpoint: http://otel-collector:4318
              insecure: true
              protocol: http/protobuf
          interval: 10000
          timeout: 5000
    resource:
      host.name: ${env:OTEL_K8S_NODE_NAME}
      k8s.namespace.name: ${env:OTEL_K8S_NAMESPACE}
      k8s.node.ip: ${env:OTEL_K8S_NODE_IP}
      k8s.node.name: ${env:OTEL_K8S_NODE_NAME}
      k8s.pod.ip: ${env:OTEL_K8S_POD_IP}
      k8s.pod.name: ${env:OTEL_K8S_POD_NAME}
